## 1-D simulation

```{r}
set.seed(123)
n <- 2000
x <- runif(n, 0, 10)
sigma2 <- 0.05 + (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(2 * pi * x / 10))
y <- x + rnorm(n, sd = sqrt(sigma2))

fit_1d <- fit_meanvar_1d(y, x)
plot(fit_1d, which = "variance_curve")
plot(fit_1d, which = "std_resid")
```

## High-D simulation

```{r}
set.seed(456)
n <- 3000
p <- 20
X <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), nrow = n, ncol = p)

mu <- X[, 1] + 0.5 * X[, 2]^2 - 0.75 * (X[, 3] > 0)
sigma2 <- exp(0.2 * X[, 4] - 0.3 * X[, 5] + 0.5 * X[, 4] * X[, 5]) + 0.1
y <- mu + rnorm(n, sd = sqrt(sigma2))

fit_hd <- fit_mean_variance(
  y, X,
  mean_backend = "ranger",
  var_backend = "rf_smooth",
  projection = "var_pred",
  seed = 456
)

plot(fit_hd, which = "variance_curve")
plot(fit_hd, which = "std_resid")

sigma2_hat <- fit_hd$sigma2_hat
ise <- mean((sigma2_hat - sigma2)^2)
r2_fit <- (y - fit_hd$mu_hat)^2
ise_const <- mean((mean(r2_fit) - sigma2)^2)

ise
ise_const
```
